EIGHTHS_PER_POINT.quantity: eighths of a point a border width is stated in

FIFTIETHS_OF_A_PERCENT.quantity: fiftieths of a percent a table's width is stated in

PASSES.quantity: layout passes made while page numbers change how lines wrap

TOLERANCE.quantity: difference between two lengths below which they count as equal

WORD_2007_MODE.quantity: the compatibility mode a document that states none is laid out in

WORD_2010_MODE.quantity: the compatibility mode at which Word breaks lines between Chinese and Japanese characters
